source: Sorted Master SPEC SHEET - V2 (owner's local copy). Workbooks are not committed; SHA-256 identifies each file read.
matchRule: A current-website record is filled only when a visible sheet's MODEL # / Item# cell equals its SKU after removing spaces, dots, underscores and hyphens. SMART, colour, size and other suffixes must match exactly. Hidden sheets, file names and the V2 CSV reports are not used for matching.
excluded: Supplier/creator fields, master-carton and case-pack data, internal part numbers (meter model, belt and bearing sizes), Pantone codes, template instructions and examples, N/A placeholders, and order-specific remarks.
